purpose: Choose fixed initial bounds for proof-first Hash-backed structural shape inference before adding the production type representation.

safety_policy.bound_failure: return an explained Unknown; never truncate fields, variants, aliases, or iterations

method.shape_candidate: Hash literal containing only Symbol or String literal keys and no splat
method.field_width: number of entries in one shape candidate
method.shape_depth: root shape counts as one; recursively nested shape values add one; arrays are traversed without adding a shape level
method.union_width: number of direct exact-shape terminal variants in an if expression
method.alias_width: number of simultaneously visible local names statically copied from one exact Hash literal identity within one lexical method scope
method.solver_measurement: headless check aggregate over the neutral repository corpus

selection_rationale.fields_per_shape: 32 covers more than three times the measured monorepo p99 while bounding the observed 232-field outlier.
selection_rationale.nested_shape_depth: 8 covers the maximum observed nested shape depth and rejects deeper unreviewed structures.
selection_rationale.shape_variants_per_union: 8 is twice the maximum observed direct conditional variant count.
selection_rationale.live_aliases_per_mutable_identity: 8 is more than twice the maximum observed local alias set.
selection_rationale.shape_solve_iterations: 16 is more than five times the measured average recursive component iterations and twice the maximum observed shape depth. A hit remains a proof failure, not permission to publish the current approximation.

limitations: The syntax scan measures literal candidates and direct conditionals; it does not claim complete runtime Hash usage coverage.

The alias scan intentionally excludes globals, instance variables, containers, reflective aliases, and interprocedural escape because those are invalidation boundaries, not evidence for increasing the precise alias limit.
The 15 neutral-repository parse errors are malformed-code fixtures; they contribute no shape observation.
Phase 8 must measure retained shape counts, bound hits, latency, allocation, and RSS before release acceptance.
decision: Accept these bounds for the initial representation and RED contract. Any future increase requires new aggregate evidence and release-profile memory and latency measurements.
